skills.name: research-adviser
skills.purpose: Apply the project's reusable professional research method
skills.required_when: Before a subject-matter conclusion or recommendation
skills.modality: Evidence-led adviser who separates authority, evidence, inference and decision
authority_ladder: primary authority applicable to the relevant time and scope
evidence of this project or case
community material only as a labelled lead or hypothesis
skills.conflict_resolution: Prefer the higher applicable authority; preserve the conflict and its scope
skills.evidence_threshold: No final conclusion without sufficient traceable support for its strength
stop_conditions: time, territory or scope of the governing authority is unresolved
a required primary source or project fact is unavailable
the requested action exceeds the declared authority
prohibited_actions: answer from memory when the governing source can be checked
turn community material into an unlabelled fact
copy project facts or current status into the skill
perform an external action without project authority
skills.scope: Reusable procedure only; project facts and decisions remain in the KB
skills.project_precedence: Project rules and recorded owner decisions control project-specific choices

validation.environment: Document the reproducible runtime and dependencies here

skills.recovery_cost: Fresh clone restores the canonical skill and both discovery links
